findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 描述 eBay 營收來源為 Marketplace 佣金與 Advertising 廣告費，以 GMV 抽成（take rate）為主，策略聚焦 enthusiasts 與 AI；未見訂閱化或 D2C 轉型表述。
findings.excerpt: We generate net revenues through two activities, Marketplace activities which primarily consist of commissions from the service of connecting buyers and sellers on our secure and trusted Marketplace platforms and Advertising activities, which primarily consist of fees charged to sellers to promote their listings.

findings.claim: eBay 用戶協議自 2026-02-20 起禁止 buy-for-me 代理／LLM 機器人未經人工審核下單，同時自建 agentic 購物
findings.source: Resultsense: eBay bans AI shopping agents
findings.excerpt: Effective 20 February 2026, eBay’s updated terms specifically prohibit “buy-for-me agents, LLM-driven bots, or any end-to-end flow that attempts to place orders without human review” without platform permission.

findings.claim: eBay 2026-10-20 宣布重組，裁員約9%，成本 1.3–1.5 億美元
findings.excerpt: On October 20, 2026, we announced a restructuring plan (the “Plan”) intended to align our teams and resources with our strategic priorities to drive long-term sustainable growth. The Plan includes a reduction of our current global workforce by approximately 9%.
